name: Rp Custom Woodworking LLC
old_description: We worked with Carson to build a raised deck in our backyard. This was outside the scope of his normal work, but easily within his skill set. In fact, I'm convinced that if it's anything to do with wood he will figure it out and do high quality work! He was very easy to work with - quick to respond to texts and emails, always ready to adjust and problem-solve as new challenges arose (as they did!). He has great relationships with wood sourcers, and will knows how to pick out high quality product. We are incredibly happy with our new cedar deck and highly recommend Carson for any project you can imagine.
about:
Rp Custom Woodworking LLC operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where founder Carson runs a custom woodworking shop. The business focuses on built-to-order pieces rather than volume production, serving clients across the Wasatch Front from its Morton Drive location.

The shop delivers custom woodworking, cabinetry, furniture, tables and desks, and exterior structures such as raised decks. A recent project included cabinetry for a restaurant service station, while a residential client received a cedar deck built from lumber sourced through the owner's supplier network. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include homeowners seeking one-off furniture or deck builds and commercial operators needing fitted cabinetry for hospitality spaces. The restaurant service station job and the residential deck illustrate the range from light commercial millwork to outdoor residential carpentry.

Carson emphasizes responsiveness and on-the-fly problem solving, noting that he adjusts plans as challenges arise during a build. He also highlights his relationships with wood suppliers as a way to secure high-grade lumber for each project.
